messages:
Eloise: Quick heads-up — HelioSys (SI) is blocked on a private deployment for MediScale. They say the image boots but our sidecar can't reach the KMS proxy. Asking for an architecture sanity check. TL;DR: port/egress mismatch? :eyes:
Marco: Can you paste the error/logs? Which subnet/VPC and which KMS flow (internal proxy vs customer HSM)?
Eloise: From HelioSys: 
```
[2026-03-20T15:12:03Z] sidecar: connect tcp 10.4.7.2:8443: i/o timeout
sidecar: attempt=3 host=proxy.internal.redwood.svc
```
They say port 8443 is allowed in their firewall rules but nothing from our side hits the proxy. Region is us-west-2, VPC peering + TGW.
Priya: @Marco can you confirm the proxy lives in the control-plane VPC or customer VPC for Private deployments? If it's control-plane we route via the peering/TGW and enforce egress ACLs — somebody might've tightened the subnet NACL recently.
Marco: Proxy is in control-plane VPC for this customer (flagged as private-proxy mode). NACLs look fine on the control plane but I see a deny rule on the customer's transit VPC that would block 8443 specifically (it was added during a marketplace hardening change).
Dan: Ugh. That change was rolled last week for marketplace images. @Priya we need a safe rollback or we miss MediScale go-live Friday. Can HelioSys pivot to an alternate port temporarily?
Priya: They tried 443 and it works to the proxy but the cert SAN expects 8443 for the sidecar after auth handshake — so long-term not viable. Short-term we can inject an iptables redirect in the sidecar to map 8443->443, but that'll need a signed image or a runtime init script.
Eloise: HelioSys prefers not to rebuild. Can we patch the control-plane transit rule for this customer only? What's the impact?
Marco: We can add a customer-scoped allow for 10.4.0.0/16 -> control-proxy:8443 and keep the global deny. That matches our least-privilege goal. Risk: adds one rule in TGW policy; I'd like approvals from security.
Dan: I'll loop in sec-ops. In parallel, Eloise, please ask HelioSys to try the iptables workaround as a stopgap — provide this snippet: 
```bash
sudo iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -p tcp --dport 8443 -j REDIRECT --to-port 443
```
If they confirm it works we have two paths.
Eloise: On it. Escalating to HelioSys now. Integrations bot: create ticket?
integrations-bot: Ticket created: PARTNER-5392 — "HelioSys private-proxy 8443 blocked for MediScale; patch or rule exception needed". Assigned to Marco, Priya. ETA: 4h for rule change approval.
Marco: I'll prepare the minimal TGW policy diff and a risk note for sec-ops.
Priya: Also flagging ops runbook update: when we roll marketplace hardening, add a customer-impact checklist to avoid accidental port blocks.
Eloise: HelioSys replied — iptables redirect worked, sidecar sees the proxy, auth succeeded. They want the TGW exception for stability.
Dan: Great. Marco, please proceed with the scoped allow and notify sec-ops that it's a targeted exception tied to PARTNER-5392.
Marco: Will do. I'll post the policy diff here once approved. :thumbsup:
Eloise: Thanks everyone — keeping MediScale on track. I'll close this thread once I get the final policy diff and HelioSys confirmation that they can remove the temporary redirect.
